results.name: REPORT(7).txt
content:
Docker failure diagnosis and isolated packaging candidate

The exact failed operation was docker build, with runner exit 1. BuildKit failed
the build stage at apps/web/Dockerfile:11, RUN npm run build (inner shell exit 1).
The compiler could not resolve ../work/public from
apps/web/src/features/portfolio/objectives/objective-work-sources.ts:6:1.
The frozen source contains the exact-case target public.ts (Git blob
21b2b00fe0f3ef96dcbe8c4771570fd3240f4f75). Root .dockerignore line 17,
**/work, removes that target's parent and the Portfolio Work route from the
Docker context. No Dockerfile-specific ignore override exists.

Evidence covers all 340 events from the Docker gate at
2026-10-12T20:05:54.931000+00:00 through build termination,
with forward pagination reaching a fixed point. Five scoped read-only AWS log
calls captured 99,174 response bytes including the initial overlapping tail.
Original response pages and tokens are private under work/.../private only;
this packet includes safe metadata/hashes, fixed error fragments and source.
It does not contain raw log bodies, stderr, tokens or private requests.

The isolated patch changes one line, **/work to work. Static context checks over
5,007 archive paths restore all 10 Work feature files and its route, with no
newly excluded paths. All 19 targeted static checks passed; root work,
node_modules, .next, environment files, evidence, outputs, docs and test artifacts
stay excluded. All other ignore lines and the pinned Dockerfile remain exact.
An initial preparation assertion expected only the 10 feature files; it also
found the Work route. That failed expectation is preserved and corrected by
the separate validator; the candidate itself was unchanged.

These are static model checks, not actual Docker/Moby or compile/smoke passes.
Node v24.19.0 is installed. Docker targets a local named pipe, but the daemon
pipe is missing. Go was not found on PATH or checked standard locations.
No service, runtime, image, credentials or Docker configuration was installed
or changed. Earlier gates returning zero is inferred from the reviewed runner
entering Docker build; individual test counts are not asserted. Smoke and
pre-push size never qualified; the prior terminal check found no ECR image.

Frontend owner integration, an actual local Linux context/build/smoke check,
and a new reviewed source commit/custody/authorization are prerequisites to
any further paid AWS attempt. This candidate does not authorize or perform one.
Both consumed attempts, frozen source/S3 version, controllers, ledgers,
releases, historical packets and private captures remain byte-identical.

Docker matching references:
https://docs.docker.com/build/concepts/context/#dockerignore-files
https://github.com/moby/patternmatcher/blob/main/patternmatcher.go
